title: LOME 04497: Request for Info on Possible Satellite Break Up or Other Aerial Phenomena, July 31, 1987
doc_notes: This document is a Department of State cable from the U.S. Embassy in Lome requesting information regarding a reported aerial phenomenon observed on July 27, 1987.

incidents.summary: Multiple callers reported a burning object flying low in the sky on a north-south trajectory near Lome Airport.
incidents.quote: SEVERAL CALLERS REPORTED TO LOME AIRPORT THAT THEY SAW A BURNING OBJECT FLYING LOW IN THE SKY
